learning_outcomes.text: To understand the basic principles of optical instruments.
To apply knowledge in lab reports.
To acquire the measurement techniques for these devices.

syllabus_topics: Human eye and vision, eye characteristics, aberrations.
Microscope: Abbe type, stereo, confocal, slit lamp
Microscope: polarization, fluorescent, interference contrast; phase specimens
Collimator, autocollimator. Surveying telescopes, periscope, binoculars. Focusing system.
Astronomical telescopes´ mounts. Large telescopes, segmented mirrors.
Reflection optics´ aberrations, corrections. Catadioptric systems.
Problems and laboratory work related to lectures.
bibliography: Williams Ch., Becklund O.: Optics: A Short Courese for Engineers and Scientists, Wiley, 1972
Kingslake R.: Optical System Design, Academic Press, London, 1983
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
